definitions.full: H1528. gir [ גִּיר ] noun [masculine] chalk, plaster (so ᵑ7 ; Biblical Hebrew once, p. 162); — emphatic גִּירָא Dan 5:5 . [ גַּלְגַּל ] see גלל . below

occurrences.englishText: In the same hour, the fingers of a man’s hand came out and wrote near the lamp stand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace. The king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
